config.expression: if({view.custom.mode} = 'heatup', 'Heat-up from cold tunes the Fast PID while the oven climbs, which is when its dynamics matter most. 1) Oven empty and cold (see the checklist). 2) Press Arm: nothing is written to the PLC, the capture only records. 3) Press Start Heat on the zone page as usual. The capture waits up to 30 minutes for the burner. 4) Leave it alone until PV has been at SP for 3 minutes, or press Finish now. 5) Review the result, apply, and watch the next heat-up. Revert if it is worse.', if({view.custom.p.kind} = 'tension', 'SP bumps tune the loop while the line runs with material (about 2 minutes). The test bumps the tension SP up, back, down and back, recording PV and the PID output every 0.1 s, then restores the SP. Do not splice, index, change speed or download a recipe during the test. The tension tags must be on the fast tag group (see the README); otherwise the test refuses to start.', 'SP bumps at steady state tune the Auto PID. The zone stays in auto control the whole time. The test bumps the SP up, back, down and back (about 25 minutes), records PV and CV every second, then restores the SP. Use an empty oven that has been steady at SP for 10 minutes or more. Do not download a recipe, open doors or change other zones during the test.'))
'Ready to start? (green = ok, red = fix first, grey = you confirm)'

config.script:
user = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	cal1615.tunerun.finish(user)
	self.view.custom.msg = 'Finishing: analysing what was captured.'

config.expression: if({view.custom.confirm} = 'start', if({view.custom.mode} = 'heatup', 'Arm the capture on ' + {view.custom.p.label} + '? Nothing is written to the PLC. After arming, press Start Heat on the zone page. The capture waits up to 30 minutes for the burner.', 'This will move the ' + {view.custom.p.label} + ' setpoint by +/- ' + toStr(coalesce({view.custom.bump}, 0)) + ' ' + {view.custom.p.units} + ' for ' + if({view.custom.p.kind} = 'tension', 'about 2 minutes', 'about 25 minutes') + ', then restore it. It stops and restores the setpoint on any fault, a runaway, or Abort. If someone else changes the setpoint, it stops and leaves their value alone.'), if({view.custom.confirm} = 'apply', 'Write the suggested Kp and Ki to the PLC now? The old values are kept so you can revert.', if({view.custom.confirm} = 'revert', 'Put the previous Kp and Ki back?', '')))

if({view.custom.run.running}, if({view.custom.run.phase} = 'waiting for heat', 'Armed: waiting for the burner (press Start Heat on the zone page)', if({view.custom.run.phase} = 'heating', 'Capturing the heat-up', 'Running: ' + coalesce({view.custom.run.phase}, ''))) + '   elapsed ' + numberFormat(coalesce({view.custom.run.elapsed}, 0) / 60, '0.0') + ' min', 'Idle')
'The PLC PID works on ' + coalesce({view.custom.sum.convention}, '?') + ' error. Only Kp and Ki are changed; Kd is left alone.'
'A simulated plant that answers the PID output, so the tuning test can be tried without the oven. Reset it, then run the test above as usual. Set Sim/enable to false to stop it.'

props.text: Gains are PLC parameters. A value entered here is sent to the HMI input the PLC loads the PID from; it takes effect on the next PLC scan. Trend: 30 min, history logged every 10 s (tension loops: use the test result for fast detail).
